name: Fettuccine Alfredo with Lentils, Bell Pepper, Zucchini & Parsley
instructions: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain and set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise, then cut crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl with the zucchini.
Peel, halve, and small dice onion. Add to the bowl.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes.
While the veggies are cooking, drain and rinse lentils. Set aside to drain further.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
When the veggies are soft, add lentils, parsley, Alfredo sauce, and spices to the skillet; stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce and lentils are warm, about 2 minutes.
Transfer drained pasta to the skillet and toss to combine. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
